content: Yerɑ Yosue u Rubɛnibɑ kɑ Gɑdibɑ sokɑ kɑ Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑn sukum mɛ mu wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ.
U bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ye Mɔwisi, Yinni Gusunɔn sɔm kowo u ɡeruɑ kpuro wee, i ye mɛm nɔɔwɑ mɑ i kuɑ mɑm mɑm ye nɛn tii nɑ bɛɛ yiire.
I ǹ bɛɛɡibu Isirelibɑ deri bɑɑ fiiko tɑbu sɔɔ sere kɑ ɡisɔ. I Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinnin ɡere mɛm nɔɔwɑwɑ.
Wee tɛ̃ u derɑ bɛɛɡibu bɑ wɛ̃re tem mɛ sɔɔ, nɡe mɛ u rɑɑ ɡeruɑ. Yen sɔ̃, i ɡɔsiro i wurɑ tem mɛ Mɔwisi, Gusunɔn sɔm kowo u bɛɛn bɑɑwure bɔnu kuɑ sɔɔ Yuudɛnin sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ, kpɑ i dɑ i sinɑ mi.

Ì n turɑ mi, i de i woodɑ ye Mɔwisi u bɛɛ wɛ̃ mɛm nɔɔwɑ mɑm mɑm. Yerɑ, i Yinni Gusunɔ kĩɔ kpɑ i win woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɑ. I de i n kɑ nùn mɑninɛ kpɑ i nùn sɑ̃ kɑ bɛɛn ɡɔ̃ru kpuro kɑ bɛɛn bwisikunu kpuro.

Yen biru u bu domɑru kuɑ mɑ u nɛɛ, i ɡɔsiro bɛɛn temɔ kɑ bɛɛn yɑɑ sɑbenu kɑ sii ɡeesu kɑ wurɑ kɑ sii ɡɑndu kɑ sii wɔ̃kusu. Arumɑni ye i ɡurɑ bɛɛn yibɛrɛbɑn min di ɡesi kpuro, i ye bɔnu koowo kɑ bɛɛn tɔn be i rɑɑ deri mi. I n mɑɑ yɛ̃ mɑ Mɔwisi u Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑn sukum tem wɛ̃ Bɑsɑniɔ Yuudɛnin sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ. Nɑ mɑɑ ben sukum bɔnu wɛ̃ sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡee nɡe mɛ nɑ Isirelibɑn bwese kɛri yi yi tie kuɑ.
Bɑ yɑ̃ku yeru bɑnɑ Yuudɛnin bɔkuɔ

Mɑ Rubɛnibɑ kɑ Gɑdibɑ kɑ Mɑnɑse be, bɑ ɡɔsirɑ bɑ dɑ ben temɔ bɑ Isirelibɑn bwese kɛri yi yi tie deri, Kɑnɑnin tem mi. Bɑ dɑ bɑ sinɑ Gɑlɑdin temɔ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ sɑɑ win sɔm kowo Mɔwisin nɔɔn di.
Ye Rubɛnibɑ kɑ Gɑdibɑ kɑ Mɑnɑsebɑn sukum bɑ Yuudɛnin dɑɑru turɑ Kɑnɑnin berɑ ɡiɑ, yerɑ bɑ yɑ̃ku yee nɑnumɡiru bɑnɑ dɑɑ ten bɔkuɔ.
Mɑ ɡoo u nɑ u Isireli be bɑ tie sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wee Rubɛnibɑ kɑ Gɑdibɑ kɑ sere Mɑnɑsebɑn sukum bɑ yɑ̃ku yeru bɑnɑ Yuudɛnin bɔkuɔ bɛsɛn berɑ ɡee.
Ye Isireli be bɑ tie bɑ nuɑ mɛ, yerɑ be kpuro bɑ mɛnnɑ Siloɔ bu kɑ ben tundo bisibu tɑbu wɔri.
Yerɑ bɑ Finɛɛsi yɑ̃ku kowo Eleɑsɑɑn bii ɡɔrɑ Gɑlɑdin tem mi, kɑ Isirelibɑn bwese kɛri wɔku ten bɑɑyeren wiruɡii bu kɑ Rubɛnibɑ kɑ Gɑdibɑ kɑ Mɑnɑse be ɡɑri ko.
Ye bɑ turɑ mi, yerɑ bɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ,
kɑ Isireli be bɑ tie kpuron yĩsirɑ sɑ kɑ bɛɛ bikiɑmɔ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i Yinni Gusunɔ seesi i bɛɛn ɑrukɑwɑni kusiɑ ye i kɑ nùn bɔkuɑ. Domi i tii yɑ̃ku yeru bɑniɑ.
I yɑɑye mɑ Peoriɔ sɑ torɑ ten bweseru kuɑ mɑ Gusunɔ u sun sɛɛyɑsiɑ. Wee, sere kɑ ɡisɔ sɑ yen wɑhɑlɑ mɔ̀. Yeni yɑ ǹ bɛɛ turɑ?
Wee tɛ̃, i nùn mɛm nɔɔbu sɑriru koosi ɡisɔ. I n yɛ̃ mɑ bɛsɛ Isirelibɑ kpuro sɔɔrɑ win mɔru yɑ koo wɔri siɑ.

Ì n mɑɑ yɛ̃ tem mi i wɑ̃ɑ mi, i ǹ kpɛ̃ i Gusunɔ sɑ̃, i ɡɔsirɑmɑ bɛsɛn mi, mi win sɑ̃ɑ yee dɛɛrɑrɑ wɑ̃ɑ. Sɑ ko bɛɛ tem wɛ̃. Yen sɔ̃, sɑ bɛɛ kɑnɑmɔ, i ku Gusunɔ seesi. I ku mɑɑ sun seesi i yɑ̃ku yeru ɡɑru bɑni.
I yɑɑyo sɑnɑm mɛ Akɑni wi u wɑ̃ɑ Serɑkin bweseru sɔɔ u torɑ ye u kɑ ɑrumɑni suɑ ye bɑ nɛɛ, ɡoo u ku suɑ. Isirelibɑ kpurowɑ Gusunɔ u seesi. Domi n ǹ Akɑni tɔnɑ u ɡu dɔmɑ te, torɑ ten sɔ̃.
Ye bɑ ɡɑri yi ɡeruɑ bɑ kpɑ, yerɑ Rubɛnibɑ kɑ Gɑdibɑ kɑ sere Mɑnɑsebɑ bɑ wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ,
Yinni Gusunɔ turowɑ u wɑ̃ɑ. Wiyɑ u yɛ̃ yèn sɔ̃ sɑ kuɑ mɛ. Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ koo mɑɑ ɡiɑ. Sɑ̀ n Yinni Gusunɔ seesi sɑ nùn torɑn nɑ, u ku de sɑ n wɑ̃ɑ.
Sɑ̀ n mɑɑ yɑ̃ku yee teni bɑnɑ bɛsɛn tiin sɔ̃n nɑ, su kɑ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinu ko ǹ kun mɛ kɛ̃nuɡinu ǹ kun mɛ siɑrɑbuɡinu, Gusunɔn tii u sun siri.
Adɑmɑ yèn sɔ̃ sɑ tu kuɑ wee, bɛrumɑ n sun mwɑ domi sɑ ǹ kĩ ɑmɛn biru bɛɛn bibun bweseru tu bɛsɛɡibu sɔ̃ tu nɛɛ, mbɑ n sun mɔɔsinɛ, bɛsɛ kɑ Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni.
Win tiiwɑ u bɛɛ tem nɔɔ burɑnɑ, u Yuudɛnin dɑɑru doke bɛsɛn suunu sɔɔ. Yen sɔ̃, sɑ ǹ bɑɑ mɔ win sɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ. Kpɑ ɑ deemɑ bɛsɛn bibun bweseru tɑ Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑru deri bɛɛn bibun sɔ̃.
Yenibɑn sɑɑbuwɑ sɑ kɑ yɑ̃ku yee teni bɑnɑ, n ǹ mɔ sɑ kĩ su tii yɑ̃kunu kuɑ.

Adɑmɑ sɑ kĩwɑ tɑ n sɑ̃ɑ seedɑ bɛsɛn bibun bweseru kɑ bɛɛn bibun bweserun sɔ̃. Kpɑ tu bu sɔ̃ɔsi mɑ sɑ rɑ Yinni Gusunɔ sɑ̃ kɑ yɑ̃kunu. Be kpuro bɑ̀ n seedɑ ye wɑ mɛ, bɛɛɡibu bɑ ǹ mɑɑ kpɛ̃ bu nɛɛ, bɛsɛɡibɑ kun bɑɑ mɔ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ.

Bɑɑ ǹ n sɑɑ yeren nɑ bɑ sun sɔ̃ɔwɑ mɛ, ǹ n mɑɑ bɛsɛn bibun bweserɑ bɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ mɛ, bɑ koo kpĩ bu bu wisi bu nɛɛ, i mɛɛrio nɡe mɛ bɛsɛn sikɑdobɑ bɑ yɑ̃ku yee teni bɑnɑ nɡe te tɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ, ɑdɑmɑ bɑ ǹ tu bɑnɛ bu kɑ tii yɑ̃kunu kuɑ mi. Seedɑn sɔ̃nɑ bɑ tu bɑnɑ.

Yen sɔ̃, i n yɛ̃ mɑ sɑ ǹ ɡɔ̃ru doke su Yinni Gusunɔ seesi kpɑ su ko nɑɑnɛ sɑriruɡibu win mi, yɑ̃ku yee tenin sɔ̃. Mɛyɑ sɑ ǹ mɑɑ kĩ su yɑ̃kunu ko ɡɑm, mɑ n kun mɔ yɑ̃ku yee ten mi, te tɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yee dɛɛrɑrɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ yɑ̃ku kowo Finɛɛsi Eleɑsɑɑn bii kɑ Isirelibɑn ɡuro ɡurobu kɑ ben yɛnu yɛ̃robu bɑ nuɑ ye Rubɛnibɑ kɑ Gɑdibɑ kɑ Mɑnɑsebɑ bɑ ɡeruɑ, yerɑ ben bwɛ̃rɑ kpunɑ.

Mɑ Finɛɛsi u Rubɛnibɑ kɑ Gɑdibɑ kɑ Mɑnɑse be sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɡisɔ sɑ ɡiɑ mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u wɑ̃ɑ kɑ bɛsɛ, domi i ǹ nùn mɛm nɔɔ sɑriru koosi. Mɛyɑ win mɔru yɑ ǹ mɑɑ wɔrimɔ bɛsɛ sɔɔ yèn bɛrum sɑ rɑɑ mɔ̀.
Yen biru Finɛɛsi wi, kɑ Isirelibɑn ɡuro ɡuro be, bɑ ɡɔsirɑ Gɑlɑdin di bɑ wurɑ bɑ beɡibu sɔ̃ɔwɑ ye bɑ nuɑ mi kpuro.
Ye beɡii be, bɑ nuɑ mɛ, yɑ bu dore. Mɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ siɑrɑ bɑ ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, bɑ ǹ mɑɑ Rubɛnin bwese kɛrɑ ye, kɑ Gɑdiɡiɑ ye wɔrimɔ bu ben tem kɑm koosiɑ.
Yen biruwɑ Rubɛnibɑ kɑ Gɑdibɑ bɑ nɛɛ, yɑ̃ku yee teni tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ seedɑ bɛsɛ kpuron wuswɑɑɔ mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ turowɑ u wɑ̃ɑ. Mɑ bɑ tu yĩsiru kɑ̃, Seedɑ.
Yosuen ɡɑri dɑ̃ɑki
